acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a garage-to-recreation-room conversion can vary significantly based on the project's scope and complexity. Factors like structural changes, the extent of utility upgrades, and finish selections all influence the duration. As a design-build firm, AKN Design Group works to establish a clear project timeline during the planning phase. We prioritize clear communication and a managed process to keep your project on track, from initial design and material sourcing through construction and final inspections, aiming for efficient completion without compromising craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration of a garage conversion depends on the project's scope, structural changes, and utility upgrades; AKN Design Group provides a clear timeline during planning.
